summary: @ornikar/eslint-config-typescript preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload
details: This version of @ornikar/eslint-config-typescript ships a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh GitHub releases, marks it executable, and uses it to run a 727KB shipped bundle `math_init.js` (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`). setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and reflected-call helpers, and the payload it launches is a heavily obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle whose contents are opaque to Node-based tooling. The preinstall fires automatically on `npm install`, and the entire mechanism — an alternate-runtime dropper invoking a large obfuscated blob whose filename (`math_init.js`) has no relation to an ESLint TypeScript config — is inconsistent with the package's stated purpose. No native source, no build step, and no legitimate need for a Bun runtime or a math-named bundle exists in an ESLint configuration package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
